question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-10) + (-3) × 6
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly to the expression (Division → Multiplication → Subtraction):

⇒ (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−3) × 6

⇒ −9 − (6) − 18

⇒ −15 − 18 = −33

**∴ The correct answer is −33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−3) × 6

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

⇒ (−9) − [(−60) ÷ (−10)] + [(−3) × 6]

First, perform the division part:

⇒ (−60) ÷ (−10) = 6

Substitute this value back into the original expression:

⇒ (−9) − 6 + (−3) × 6

Next, perform the multiplication part:

⇒ (−3) × 6 = −18

Substitute this value back into the expression:

⇒ (−9) − 6 + (−18)

Finally, perform the addition and subtraction from left to right:

⇒ −15 − 18

⇒ −33

**∴ The correct answer is −33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the correct order of operations to solve an expression: Brackets first, then Orders (powers/roots), followed by Division and Multiplication (evaluated left to right), and finally Addition and Subtraction (evaluated left to right).

Sign Rules for Multiplication and Division

Multiplying or dividing two numbers with the same sign always gives a positive result (− × − = +). Conversely, multiplying or dividing numbers with different signs always gives a negative result (+ × − = −).

Sign Rules for Addition and Subtraction

When combining two negative numbers, you add their absolute values and retain the negative sign (e.g., −9 − 6 = −15). When signs are different, subtract the smaller number from the larger and keep the sign of the larger absolute number.
